content.short: Ready Wallet is the self-custody wallet for crypto natives on Starknet.
content.description: Ready Wallet is a self-custody Web3 wallet built for crypto natives on Starknet. With over 2 million downloads, it has been redesigned to be faster, smarter, more rewarding, and genuinely fun to use. Put your crypto to work with ultra-low-fee swaps between ETH, wBTC, USDC and more; stake ETH, STRK (and soon LBTC) to earn rewards; explore DeFi protocols to generate yield; buy tokens in seconds via card or bank transfer; and send crypto from exchanges with ease.
content.meta: Ready Wallet is a self-custody Web3 wallet for crypto natives on Starknet. Discover Ready Wallet and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
